name: Blood_Line
source:
Blood_Line — Identity V fangame, which tells the story of vampires who have learned over the years to live side by side with humans, the game will also allow you to look at the history of IDV vampires from my point of view ^_^ You don’t need to know lore of original game to play!

[from [url=https://cornonoctis.itch.io/blood-line]itch.io[/url]]
